facts.fact: Interior Minister Muntaka says the NIA has cleared almost all backlogs of Ghana Cards and about 397,000 of 418,000 children registered since the child programme began have received theirs.
Interior Minister Muntaka says the Ghana Card is used for identity verification across public and private institutions, with about 284 institutions on the NIA verification platform.
Interior Minister Muntaka says more than 125 million biometric verification transactions were processed in 2025, and about 284 institutions used the platform by 13 August 2026.

GHA.note: Only the NIA's own data centre, insured; not for hire and no hosting of other state systems stated.
